description: SOURCE QUIRK: login reuses the user's existing api client and returns ITS client_id, ignoring the requested clientId

probes.description: requested client id was NOT created
probes.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'requested-but-ignored'

probes.description: new access token persisted on the existing client
probes.sql: SELECT access_token FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'crm-portal'
SELECT refresh_token <> 'seeded-refresh-token-0001' FROM api_clients WHERE client_id = 'crm-portal'
